name: Aztecs, Maya and Incas
description: The great civilizations of the Americas before Columbus, from the Olmecs and the Maya cities to the Aztec and Inca empires.

checkpoints.name: Olmecs and the early Maya
checkpoints.note: The Olmecs carve giant stone heads on the Gulf coast of Mexico and the first Maya towns appear. In the Andes, people already keep records on knotted cords.

checkpoints.name: The great Maya cities
checkpoints.note: Tikal, Palenque and other Maya cities build pyramids, write in glyphs and keep a precise calendar, while Teotihuacan grows into one of the largest cities in the world. In the ninth century many of the southern cities are abandoned.

checkpoints.name: Toltecs and Chichen Itza
checkpoints.note: Power moves north to the Toltecs and to Chichen Itza in Yucatán. In the Andes the city of Cusco is founded.

checkpoints.name: The Aztec and Inca empires
checkpoints.note: The Aztecs found Tenochtitlan on an island in a lake and build an empire across central Mexico. The Incas under Pachacuti build the largest empire in the Americas, with Machu Picchu and thousands of kilometres of roads.

checkpoints.name: The Spanish conquest
checkpoints.note: Hernán Cortés takes Tenochtitlan in 1521 and Francisco Pizarro captures the Inca emperor Atahualpa in 1532. The last Inca stronghold falls in 1572.
